name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
Major upgrade since v2.1.13

🎨 Native Ring UI, end to end — Every dialog, the settings window, and toast notifications now render with JetBrains Ring UI React components. The plugin looks and feels like a native part of YouTrack.

⚙️ Redesigned Settings — The settings window is now a clean two-pane layout (section list on the left, active section on the right) that scales to every option without clutter.

📊 Task State on the Gantt — Each task shows its current YouTrack state as a coloured badge, the previous state, and how long ago it changed; the timeline bar colour now reflects state.

💬 Polished Modals & Notifications — Consistent focus management, ARIA accessibility, and a clean click-anchored toast notification stack across all 20 dialogs.

🌍 15 UI Languages — Every new label and state badge is fully localized across all 15 supported languages.

🐛 Reliability Fixes — Single-click checkboxes and row actions in the task picker and grids, working-copy persistence across reload and tabs, a role-items schema fix, and role over-allocation now detected from the aggregate even when task estimates are empty.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
